title: What's New in v2.9.72
notes: ⚡ Dual-Mode BDC Backend & Firebase Live Queue: Migrated backend operations away from Google Apps Script to BDC Central Command with instant real-time processing via /api_queue and direct REST API.
🎮 Instant Century Games Stats & Captchas: Member token verifications, captcha dispatches, and live profile syncs now process in milliseconds with zero Google quota limits or timeouts.
🔥 Real-Time Database Sync: Member and Alt furnace levels, start dates, and avatars sync instantly across Firebase RTDB and BDC Central Command.

latestChanges: v2.9.67: Added live Developer Note callout boxes and 'YOUR TICKET' badges to notification bell alerts modal
v2.9.66: Added Roster File Import & Fast Sync (.csv, .json, .txt, .tsv) to Add Player modal with live preview and sample templates
v2.9.65: Upgraded Bug/Feedback resolution note editor to a spacious multi-line textarea with quick templates and pre-wrap formatting
v2.9.64: Enabled debounced background cloud auto-save and streamlined the Save button with live sync status indicators
